sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: rules of the road: regulatory, guide and route signs, pavement markings, lane controls and crosswalks
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Physical pages 71 and 72 are lane marking diagrams with short captions, and page 74 carries no text; marking facts here come only from the printed captions, and no line pattern is described from the pictures in part C2 [A05].
Part C's misconception line describes the mixed center line as a dashed line paired with a solid one; the caption on page 71 states only that passing is permitted when the dashed line is on your side, so the solid line detail comes from the diagram [A05].
The reversible lane and shared center left turn lane appear only as pictured captions on page 72; their operating rules are not described on these pages and are not taught here [A06].
The worker-endangerment rule cites SC Code §56-5-1535 and names a fine and points without amounts, so none are stated here [A01].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
